entities.summary: Carolyn Jordan Bourdeaux is an American politician and educator who served as the U.S. representative from Georgia's 7th congressional district from 2021 to 2023. A member of the Democratic Party, she was a professor at the Andrew Young School of Public Policy at Georgia State University from 2003 to 2021 and Director of the Georgia State Senate Budget and Evaluation Office from 2007 to 2010.
